reviews.review:
This turned out to be quite a hidden gem!

Looking at the current most popular tags (RTS, Tower Defense, Action RTS, Singleplayer), I immediately saw the tags of my dream game.

Marshals of Yore is fun, challenging, and addictive, and it strikes the perfect balance among those three factors.

The main highlight of this game is that 'war of attrition' feeling during the battles. Things can swing back and forth or even reach a sort of stalemate, and the next move can make or break the whole thing.  Sometimes I got overwhelmed by the enemy and had to restart, and sometimes I could pull it off, but even when I failed, I kept coming back for more, knowing that one slight tweak could make the difference the next time around.

The developer, most likely a single person, is aptly and humorously named One Man Horde. Hats off to this game, as this is clearly a passion project and proof that a single person, with limited resources, can still create a banger given the proper vision.  Bravo!
